title: Drag or keyboard
text: Move items with the pointer or the arrow keys, and resize with Shift and the arrows.

title: Responsive layouts
text: Layouts are stored per breakpoint and derived for narrower screens.

title: Compaction and locks
text: Items float up to fill gaps, and locked items never move.

title: Reading order
text: The DOM follows the visual order, so focus order matches what users see.

title: Widget catalog
text: Add widgets from a catalog of templates.
